content: In our future work we would like to build pre-trained ‘BERT’ model from scratch. We would pretrain the model with biomedical corpus (PubMed, ‘PMC’) and Wikipedia. Doing so would give us scope to create word piece vocabulary to include biomedical jargon and there are chances of model performing better with biomedical jargon being included in the word piece vocabulary. We will consider this scenario in the future, or wait for the next version of BioBERT.
